info.title: AgentGate gateway
info.description: The gateway's HTTP API (P1: payment core and ledger). Hand-written; TestOpenAPI_RoutesMatchMounted and TestOpenAPI_PaymentSchemaMatchesStruct keep its routes and payment schemas in step with the code (ADR-129). Problem codes and statuses are documented here but not drift-tested. Every error documented here is an RFC 9457 problem with a stable machine-readable `code`; clients branch on `code`, never on `title`. An unknown path or method gets the router's plain-text 404 or empty 405, which are not part of this contract. Every response carries X-Request-Id; every response with a body is also marked X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Cache-Control: no-store.

get.description: Answers whenever the process is serving. It checks no dependency; use /readyz for that.
Runs each readiness check (PostgreSQL, Redis, and "rail", which fails until the rail is wired). Results are cached for about a second. Check errors are never shown, only a status per check.

503.description: At least one check failed or timed out.

post.description: Creates a payment and starts settling it on the rail. Idempotent: a retry with the same Idempotency-Key and the same body, within 24 h, returns the stored response byte for byte and creates nothing (ADR-118).

requestBody.description: At most 64 KiB, exactly one JSON object, no unknown members.

201.description: The payment was created. The body is a point-in-time snapshot taken at creation, usually in state `settling`; it is never updated, and a replay returns the same bytes even after the payment has settled or failed. `settling` here does not mean stuck: GET the Location URL for the current state.

Location.description: The payment's URL, /v1/payments/{id}: GET it for the current state.

400.description: `idempotency_key_required`: the header is missing or not 1-255 bytes. `invalid_request`: the body is not a valid payment (malformed JSON, a wrong type, unknown members, trailing data, or a missing or zero payer/payee account ID; a missing `amount` or `currency` is a 422 instead).

409.description: `idempotency_key_mismatch`: the key was already used for a different request.

200.description: The payment as it is now.

400.description: `invalid_payment_id`: the id is not a UUID.

post.description: Unauthenticated. The body is only a hint: the gateway asks the rail for the payment's status and acts on that answer, never on the body (ADR-124). The answer is the same 204 whether or not the payment exists, so the status code doesn't reveal which payments exist (response timing still differs; accepted in ADR-124). Rate-limited per source (behind GATEWAY_TRUSTED_PROXIES, the client address from X-Forwarded-For; ADR-128).

requestBody.description: The gateway reads at most 1 KiB. Members other than `ref`, and anything after the JSON value, are ignored (unlike createPayment, which refuses trailing data; deliberate, ADR-124).

204.description: The hint was taken. Says nothing about whether the payment exists or what happened to it.

404.description: `unknown_rail`: the gateway has no rail by that name.

413.description: `request_too_large`: the JSON value does not end within the first 1 KiB.

429.description: `rate_limited`: too many requests from this source.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 1-255 bytes (maxLength counts characters; the limit is in bytes), chosen by the caller and unique per intended payment. Kept for 24 h.

RetryLater.description: Temporarily unavailable; retry after Retry-After (with the same Idempotency-Key, a retry is safe). `try_again_later`: the API is not wired yet (the rail isn't ready), too many concurrent transactions, or every webhook slot is taken. `request_timeout`: the request's deadline ran out.

rail.description: The rail that settles it, e.g. `internal` or `fake`.

rail_ref.description: pay_<id>, generated by the gateway when settling starts; null if the payment never reached `settling` (it is `created`, or failed from `created`).

ref.description: pay_ and the payment ID as a lower-case hyphenated UUID; the nil UUID is refused.

title.description: A short fixed summary for people; not for branching.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable; see each response for its values.
